sensitivity: label-independent representative (first completion of each relation x model)

solution_level.label: 1 if it fails canonical H
solution_level.metrics: AUC with task-cluster bootstrap; the task-level tau_div is never applied
solution_level.score: that solution's disagreement rate with the other scored solutions of its task on the RQ3 shared pool (recomputed in Stage 5 from re-executed traces, same pool seed and size)
solution_level.unit: an RQ3-scored representative solution (relation x model) that passes P

task_level.label_primary: 1 if >=1 RQ3-scored solution passes P and fails canonical H (operational disagreement with the validated hidden oracle), else 0
task_level.label_secondary: 1 if >=1 RQ3-scored solution fails P-and-H combined
task_level.metrics: AUC on the continuous score; sensitivity/specificity/J only at the frozen tau_div
task_level.population_rule: held-out split tasks, minus audit-reserved tasks, H-ready only (applied at G4); development tasks are all in the calibration half
